notes.title: Update 3.1.0
notes.notes:
Update 3.1.0 has been released. Here's what was added.

[h1][b]Additions:[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]- New mechanic - Change Element:[/b][/h2]

It is now possible to change elemental crystal during gameplay, thus maximizing damage to enemies with elemental weaknesses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400890/3c6f9cd32d20227db33e6ccf5e0fa408bb5c46ae.gif[/img]

- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 2.0.0
notes.notes:
Update 2.0.0 is out. Here is what changes/adds.

Update 2.0.0 has been released. Here's what was added/changed.

[h1][b]Additions:[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]- New mechanic - Perfect Block:[/b][/h2]

Perfect blocks when executed will provide an advantage to the player, enemies will be in slow motion.
To perform a perfect block, use the boost barrier to block an enemy projectile at the right time and the purple bar needs to be full.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400890/4ac4ee4f269144a0bb2079fc06f9ff25fe14fd3b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]- New item - Improvement Ticket.[/b][/h2]

During the game, enemies can drop upgrade tickets, which can be used in the hangar to improve the ship without having to spend crystals.

Only 1 ticket can be obtained, to obtain another use the one you have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400890/e6bfc3b91440b3e0756adc2630007a5da3cf4d36.png[/img]

[h2][b]- Class 03 ships added:[/b][/h2]

Now the player will be able to unlock class 3 ships. These ships, in addition to being more powerful, have a special improvement - minidrones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44400890/2212102bf3e7f43f46a0fe2b26e08b27da3783da.png[/img]

- 02 new maps;
- New paintings;
- New effects;
- New propellants;
- New shields;
- New missions;
- New achievements.

[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]

- Event announcements will only appear when the event appears at a certain distance from the player. For greater distances, it will be necessary to equip the Radar CPU.

- Bug fixes.
